releaseNotes:
v1.0.1-preview.24
- Renamed the shipped JavaScript modules to fireForNet-firestore-indexeddb-shared.js, fireForNet-firestore-crosstab-shared.js, fireForNet-firestore-online-state-shared.js, fireForNet-firestore-watchstream-shared.js and fireForNet-firestore-network-blazor.js. Every module name now carries an explicit flavour marker, so the same name always means the same bytes.
- The shared modules ship from physical copies in this package's own wwwroot, instead of links into the browser package. A linked copy resolved its content root to the linking project and 404ed at runtime.

v1.0.1-preview.23
- BREAKING (pre-RC contract): mutation batches and document overlays are keyed per user (composite [uid, id/path] keys) and stale IndexedDB shapes are dropped and recreated (schema 4) - no migration layer. Complete pending offline writes before upgrading. All tabs of an app must run one library version.
- Settled batches are purged per user in the same transaction as the state flip; documents persist a HasCommittedMutations flag.
- ClearAsync clears cache only (documents, field-index entries, named queries); the mutation queue and overlays survive.
- Fixed: cache byte accounting computed deltas from the just-written record (always zero) so quota eviction never ran; size reads now precede writes and per-change deltas aggregate into one metadata write.
- Fixed: replacing field-index entries on document update deleted the fresh entries via cursor/put interleaving (local queries could miss documents).
- Fixed: the deterministic eviction scan could evict the __cache_meta record; the schema-4 rebuild no longer runs on unrelated upgrades; accessSequence seeds are monotonic across restarts and query reads bump recency.
- Dispatch loops observe subscriber tasks (a faulting subscriber can no longer be lost as an unobserved task exception); BlazorNetworkDetector.Dispose delegates to DisposeAsync and waits for the JS unsubscribe to complete.

v1.0.1-preview.22
- BREAKING: mutation-batch records carry canonical state strings; cross-tab targetMismatches values are canonical strings; online-state broadcasts use canonical lowercase strings. All tabs of an app must run one library version.

v1.0.1-preview.21
- No functional changes; synchronized with the framework-free MAUI integration sweep.

v1.0.1-preview.13
- Added offline-first mutation persistence: BlazorIndexedDbLocalStore now implements ILocalStoreMutationQueue and ILocalStoreOverlayCache via BlazorIndexedDbLocalStore.Mutations.cs partial, storing mutationBatches, documentOverlays, and mutationQueueMeta object stores in the same IndexedDB database (schema version bumped to 3). Enables offline writes to survive tab reload.
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.13, which adds offline-first optimistic writes and eliminates the proto-to-JSON round-trip.

v1.0.1-preview.12
- Fixed UnobservedTaskException caused by fetch abort surfacing as JSException during WebChannel teardown. The receive loop now catches JSException alongside OperationCanceledException when the cancellation token is triggered, preventing the exception from faulting the fire-and-forget Task. Same root cause and fix as Firestore.Browser — shared WebChannel transport code paths.

v1.0.1-preview.11
- Fixed InvalidStateError: "Failed to execute 'transaction' on 'IDBDatabase': The database connection is closing" on long-running Blazor WASM sessions. Browsers tear down idle IndexedDB connections (tab backgrounding, memory pressure, version change in another tab); the cached _db handle became stale and the next operation threw. Added onversionchange/onclose handlers that null the cached handle, a getDatabase() helper that transparently reopens the connection, and converted all exported JS operations to await getDatabase() before creating a transaction. Mirrors the connection-lifecycle pattern already used by Installations.Blazor and RemoteConfig.Blazor.

v1.0.1-preview.10
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.10, which fixes the "Cursor has too many values" error on snapshot-cursor pagination queries.

v1.0.1-preview.9
- Synchronized package version with the preview.9 release.

v1.0.1-preview.8
- Added IndexedDB QuotaExceededError handling: JS detects quota errors via QUOTA_EXCEEDED: prefix, C# catches, evicts via CollectGarbageAsync, retries once, surfaces BlazorFirestoreException(LocalCacheFull) if eviction cannot recover.
- Eliminated localStorage backend (BlazorLocalStorageLocalStore, BlazorLocalStorageInterop, LocalStoreKind enum, LocalStoreKind options property) — no official Firestore JS SDK counterpart; IndexedDB is the only supported browser persistence backend.
- Split BlazorIndexedDbLocalStore into partial classes by interface concern (Documents, Indexes, Cache) for SRP and maintainability.
- Extracted IBlazorIndexedDbInterop interface for testability; quota-retry logic is now unit-testable via interface substitution.
- Added _disposed guard to EnsureInitializedAsync to throw typed BlazorFirestoreException instead of ObjectDisposedException.
- BlazorFirestoreException now extends FirebaseCoreException<FirestoreErrorCode> directly.

v1.0.0-preview9
- Initial release. Replaces FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore.Blazor.WebAssembly.
- IJSRuntime-based IndexedDB, localStorage, and network detection interop for all Blazor hosting models (WASM, Server, Hybrid, Auto).
- UseBlazor() extension method on FirestoreBuilder for service registration.
- No dependency on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore.Browser — references core Firestore package directly.
- JS modules are identical to the Browser package (shared ES module exports).
